scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance for Quality Certification
other_conditions: The firm must be a Micro, Small or Medium enterprise (MSME).
The enterprise must be run by an SC or ST entrepreneur.
The enterprise must apply within one year from the date of certification issuance.
The enterprise should belong to the manufacturing sector.
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹1,00,000 subsidy for ERP system costs and up to ₹10,00,000 assistance for quality certification fees and related testing equipment.
